## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the change. `uv run pytest` and `cd frontend && pnpm test && pnpm check` pass.
- [ ] An API change is in `docs/api.md` first, in its own commit.
- [ ] A new or changed text is in `en.json`, `pl.json` and `qqq.json`.
- [ ] A change users can see is in `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
